note: Dynamic-probe (ablation/perturbation) CALIBRATION subsets. Attacks and outcome evaluation always use the FULL task set; only the feature-estimation probes are subsetted.
selection_rule: Predeclared and outcome-blind: within each frozen fold, take the first n task ids in lexicographic order. No attack outcome is consulted. Sizes were set by analysis/probe_subset_stability.py, which compares feature estimates to feature estimates only.

evidence.customer_service: 20 tasks IS the full CS set, so rho@20=1.000 is trivially true and is not evidence. The informative figure is rho@10 = 0.887 ablation / 0.839 perturbation, which is why CS is not cut below 20.
evidence.software_engineering: rho vs the full 50-task estimate: 20 tasks 0.544 ablation / 0.430 perturbation (clearly unstable); 30 tasks 0.754 / 0.893 (marginal); 40 tasks 0.970 / 0.961 (stable). 40 chosen.
